item.title: August 04, 2026 - When is a secret not a secret?
item.description: Page 226. "Addicts tend to live secret lives...It is a great relief to get rid of all our secrets and to share the burden of our past." Just for Today: My secrets can make me sick only as long as they stay secret. Today, I will talk with my sponsor about my secrets.
